scope.identityStatement: This source-authored projectile material is a compatibility candidate, not the same asset as Unity built-in Material 10303, and its rendering behavior is unverified. Its referenced exported shader is a dummy shader body, so this candidate does not currently satisfy the functional-equivalence condition. Preserve the original prefab unchanged; any future mapping must use a separately scoped runtime/package overlay and retain the original pointer.

requiredEvidence: The original projectile-fragment feature and candidate overlay produce equivalent fragment lifecycle, physics, collision, and gameplay effects.
Rendering behavior is compared against a source-backed original-game reference at representative runtime conditions.
The test exercises the exact package and code SHA proposed for integration and reports any differences.
